items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I remember this bass player, Jack Lander, (unintelligible) in Canada, told me Ray

ctx.x: Because I never thought she knew what she was singing, or cared.

She talked to him like a dog, man. She's evil. She led him on. But I remember this bass player, Jack Lander, (unintelligible) in Canada, told me Ray -- I never really knew him that well. We were talking about bass, -- hey, you. Hey, you.
